## History

Before entering the foreign field as a missionary, Elizabeth used to write stories. In her work abroad, she devoted herself to serving others and sharing her faith. Through her dedication to her missionary calling, she set aside her former literary pursuits to focus entirely on her ministry.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P11](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0011)_
